workloads.name: Distributed Raft Consensus Split-Brain & Invariant Violation
workloads.description: Isolate the exact term, candidate ID, and log index where the Raft Election Safety Invariant broke in a 35,000-line concurrent trace without dumping the log into context.
workloads.prompt_unoptimized: Analyze heavy_workloads/raft_consensus/logs/raft_cluster_trace.log and determine the exact term, candidate ID, and log index where the Raft Election Safety invariant was violated. Provide the line number and conflicting leaders.
workloads.prompt_optimized: Use $astra-ultra. Apply bounded log slicing and error filtering on heavy_workloads/raft_consensus/logs/raft_cluster_trace.log to isolate the Raft Election Safety invariant violation. Report the term, candidate ID, log index, line number, and conflicting leaders in under 10 lines.

workloads.name: High-Concurrency MVCC Delta Chain & ARIES Rollback Race
workloads.description: Identify the missing version unlinking race condition in TransactionManager.abort causing dirty reads across concurrent checkpoints.
workloads.prompt_unoptimized: Inspect the MVCC storage engine implementation in heavy_workloads/mvcc_storage/ and identify the missing version unlinking race condition in TransactionManager.abort that causes dirty reads across concurrent checkpoints.
workloads.prompt_optimized: Use $astra-ultra. Use AST skeletons and bounded slices to inspect heavy_workloads/mvcc_storage/ and locate the missing version unlinking bug in TransactionManager.abort. Output the exact file, method, line range, and race condition explanation.
